{{Intro/Resonator|Hiyuki|lang=ja=緋雪}} She is a {{W|miko}} and member of the [[Special Response Force]] with a long-standing connection to the [[Threnodian]]s. Her stoic, aloof demeanor and formidable combat experience conceal guilt and regret for failing to protect her homeland that continues to weigh heavily in her heart. Having served as a miko for over a century, Hiyuki derives her most anomalous capabilities from "Suzu", one of the five [[Legacy Talismans]] left behind by the [[Sentinel]]s, which grants the bearer the ability to perceive and utilize "certain possibilities" of oneself.
